text_block_list.text:
I don't even know how I'm supposed to
face
everyone now...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All those people cheered for someone
like me...
for nothing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

Maybe this truly is as good as I'll ever
be.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Setting unrealistic expectations won't do
either of
us any good.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even so... do you truly think that this loser can improve?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Take responsibility and train me. I'll
endure it,
however hard it may be.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Can you help me become someone
worth
believing in?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Thank you. I won't forget what
you just
said.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sorry... I'm such a helpless idiot.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've known that all along, but still... I just
can't
give up...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
'Cause I don't think I can just give up
yet!
